codex_note:
## Codex adaptation boundary

This mirror maintains only the explicitly selected project-local verification skill under `.agents/skills/verify-*/`. The coordinator owns the live pass and proof-orchestrator selects its proof level. Source readers may use native bounded delegation when exposed, but the sequential fallback is only a declared path here, not a live proof. A missing or unhealthy target is `blocked` with the attempted route and prerequisite. The maintenance flow never edits product code or global skills, and it never opens, publishes, or merges a PR without separate authorization. The bounded fixture reruns the real disposable CLI, performs syntax/version/health Doctor, records one source-wave result per feature, reconciles only its own feature files, cleans app state, persists before/after evidence, and reports `FIXTURE_ONLY`; a separate disposable web fixture was also re-driven through the native Codex in-app browser after drift removal with accessibility-tree and screenshot evidence. It does not claim live target coverage, PR, or native host activation.
codex_rule: Respect native Codex model/effort, permissions and actual tool availability; no automatic Cursor runtime equivalence.
preserved_requirement: Periodic pass that keeps a project's verification skill and feature map honest: parallel source readers per feature, one live session driving every feature, at most one PR of proven corrections. Use for /maintain-verification-skill or "audit the verify skill".
proof: Pinned source hash and deterministic renderer are static provenance. Focused tests render the held candidate, exercise path-state selection, run a real disposable notes CLI with syntax/version/health Doctor, record source-wave/feature-map evidence, introduce controlled drift in one feature file, clean app state, persist maintenance-before/after stdout/stderr/exit evidence, reconcile the project-local map, and pass a second clean execution. A separate native in-app-browser pass re-drove both mapped web features after the drift was removed, including no-match and reload/persistence checks with accessibility-tree and screenshot evidence. Evidence survives cleanup; pre-existing cleanup paths and unsafe names are rejected. The outcome is fixture-only: source-wave delegation, production live driving, native runner/host activation, and PR correction remain unproven.
reason: The adapter changes the project-local target path and delegation boundary while leaving the pinned upstream source unchanged.
